fields.statement: QA by hand with this branch built to a scratch binary, in a fresh git repo with RHIZA_* env cleared: a plan workflow (one wait step on ../go) started with run start --foreground --no-wait stopped at step one; rhiza land landed its record change set (state landed); after touching ../go, rhiza run resume --foreground <run> continued visit 1, passed, and ended succeeded with exit 0 (run status --json state succeeded). In the same repo a hand-written ship-change journal on the landed change set was refused with exit 3, "is landed, no longer accepted" and next: rhiza run abandon BUILDLAND01, journal byte-identical; a plan journal on a rejected change set was refused with exit 3, "is rejected, no longer accepted", next: rhiza run abandon PLANREJ01, journal unchanged. As a control, the merge-base binary run through the same script refused the landed plan run (exit 3, run stayed stopped).
